Title: Generally Available: ICMP Support for Azure Standard V2 NAT Gateway

Body.Content:
Azure StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports outbound ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply traffic, enabling customers to use tools such as ping to quickly validate outbound connectivity and troubleshoot network issues from workloads behind StandardV2 NAT Gateway. This support extends to IPv4 and IPv6 for existing and new StandardV2 SKU NAT Gateways. 

Learn more:   

  • ICMP Ping Support through Azure NAT Gateway  
  • Azure NAT Gateway overview  
  • Troubleshoot Azure NAT Gateway
